source_id: CW-VH-01 online direct caretaker rejection; BW-VH-01 path
purpose: Exercise the online booking decision path: direct caretaker rejection.
preconditions: No booking record exists initially; the actors and booking data stated in this workflow are available.
action_or_input: Indenter submits a valid online booking; state becomes Pending. Then Caretaker rejects the pending request.
expected_result: The workflow records the decision path and ends with booking state Rejected. Offline designation is retained for offline cases.

preconditions: No booking record exists initially; the actors and booking data stated in this workflow are available.
action_or_input: Indenter submits a valid online booking; state becomes Pending. Then Caretaker forwards the pending request; VH In-Charge approves it.
expected_result: The workflow records the decision path and ends with booking state Approved. Offline designation is retained for offline cases.

source_id: CW-VH-02 exactly 7 days before arrival branch; BW-VH-07 path
purpose: Exercise cancellation timing and confirmation path for exactly 7 days before arrival.
preconditions: A booking exists before arrival and the recorded room-rent basis is available.
action_or_input: The Indenter requests cancellation exactly 7 days before arrival; VHMS records charge 0%. The Caretaker reviews and confirms the cancellation.
expected_result: The booking is cancelled, billing is adjusted, and the applicable charge is 0%.

source_id: CW-VH-02 within 7 days before arrival, excluding same-day branch; BW-VH-08 path
purpose: Exercise cancellation timing and confirmation path for within 7 days before arrival, excluding same-day.
preconditions: A booking exists before arrival and the recorded room-rent basis is available.
action_or_input: The Indenter requests cancellation within 7 days before arrival, excluding same-day; VHMS records charge 25% of one-day room rent. The Caretaker reviews and confirms the cancellation.
expected_result: The booking is cancelled, billing is adjusted, and the applicable charge is 25% of one-day room rent.

purpose: Exercise the approved stay transition through room allotment, check-in, and check-out.
preconditions: A booking is in Approved state and ready for room allotment.
action_or_input: Caretaker records room allotment (Approved -> Room Allotted), guest check-in (Room Allotted -> Checked In), and guest check-out (Checked In -> Checked Out).
expected_result: The stay follows the stated progression and ends in Checked Out state.
